report.summary: Both failures come from one cause: the app's list_books() sleeps a random 0-8 seconds (app/main.py:150), and the UI tests run under a 5 s Playwright timeout (tests/ui/conftest.py:7). Whenever the sleep runs long, the /books page load or the post-submit redirect to /books exceeds 5 s. This is flaky, not a product bug, and the first fix is to remove or bound that sleep in app/main.py.

causes.title: Random 0-8 s delay in list_books() exceeds the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database (app/main.py:149-150). The /books page renders through render_books(), which calls list_books() (app/main.py:256), so every GET /books, and every POST /books that re-renders or redirects to /books, can take up to 8 s. tests/ui/conftest.py:7 sets the default Playwright timeout to 5000 ms. When the random draw is above roughly 5 s (about 3/8 of runs), Page.goto('/books') times out in the logout test. In the books test, the Add book click submits the form, and Playwright waits for the resulting navigation (the 303 to /books) to finish, which also times out. Because the delay is random, the same code passes on other runs. The second test's later assertions (error text, kept input) never ran, so they are not yet verified against this run.

search_code for random|sleep found only app/main.py:9, app/main.py:150 in app code
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) call from list_books() in app/main.py. If the latency is deliberate (for example, to exercise waits), keep it out of the default path or make it configurable and disabled in the test run. Do not just raise the test timeout, because the 8 s worst case still exceeds the 5 s limit and the test-side comment says the app should be fast. After the fix, rerun both tests several times to confirm they are stable.
